configure_general_purpose_subagent: configure the general-purpose subagent with a SubagentConfig instance for complex multi-step tasks
set_disallowed_tools: set disallowed tools on the subagent config to prevent task, ask_clarification, and present_files nesting
configure_system_prompt: configure the system prompt for the general-purpose subagent with guidelines and output format
set_working_directory: set the working directory and mount paths for the general-purpose subagent sandbox environment
configure_subagent_max_turns: configure the general-purpose subagent with max_turns and model inheritance settings
